meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速制作并渲染视频动画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量生成视频内容
copy.tagline_en: Create and render video animations quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate video content in batches

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会改用 HyperFrames 的命令行流程来制作视频/动画：搜索现成效果→搭建项目→检查修改→预览→渲染成 MP4，也能交给云端等服务远程渲染。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 制作或修改视频/动画，或让它排查构建、渲染失败时，这套流程会接管；材料齐备并预览通过、你批准后才会渲染。

say.text: 帮我在目录里搜一个逐行揭示标题的动画效果
say.note: 会在本地检索现成效果，返回可直接安装的候选

say.text: 检查这个 HyperFrames 项目，有问题及时说
say.note: 会先跑 lint，再做浏览器审计和对比度检查

say.text: 我确认预览没问题，按高清渲染出 out.mp4
say.note: 没获批准前不会渲染，渲染后还会校验输出

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives video/animation work through HyperFrames CLI: searches premade effects, scaffolds projects, checks edits, previews, and renders MP4s locally or via remote cloud services.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks Claude to create or edit a video/animation, or to diagnose build/render failures; it waits for final preview approval before rendering.

say_en.text: Find an effect that reveals a headline line by line.
say_en.note: Searches the local catalog and returns installable candidates.

say_en.text: Check this HyperFrames project and flag any issues.
say_en.note: Runs lint, then browser audit and contrast checks.

say_en.text: I've approved the preview — render high quality to out.mp4.
say_en.note: It won't render before approval, and verifies the output after.
